description: Video editor designed for use with Claude Code (Python-engine timeline editing, preview, and export). Formerly claude-cut.
untrusted.description: Opening a project executes its effects/*.py scripts and the Python specified in its timeline, so Mittler only runs in trusted folders.
welcome.explorer:
Start a Mittler (video editor) project:
[Mittler: New Project](command:mittler.newProject)
config.language.description: Editor UI language (en = English, ja = Japanese). You can also change it from the toggle at the right end of the editor's top bar, which updates this setting. Command names and setting descriptions follow VS Code's display language.
config.render.python.description: Python executable used for preview and export rendering (must include numpy, opencv, and Pillow). Example: C:\venv\mittler\Scripts\python.exe. If empty, searches in order: the timeline's render.python (or this Mittler installation's default location, if configured) → a render-capable Python on PATH. Running “Mittler: Setup” fills this in automatically when installing an environment. Rendering always runs on the PC where the extension runs (connect with Remote-SSH to render on another PC).
config.render.ffmpegDir.description: Directory containing ffmpeg and ffprobe for rendering (when not on PATH). Example: C:\ffmpeg\bin. If empty, searches in order: this Mittler installation's default location (if configured and present) → PATH.
config.analysis.python.description: Python executable used for analysis (YOLO11, demucs, faster-whisper, librosa, rembg). If empty, searches in order: the timeline's settings.analysis_python → this Mittler installation's default location (if configured).
config.analysis.modelsDir.description: Directory where analysis models are stored (passed to the analysis process as the AV_AI_MODELS environment variable). If empty, searches in order: the AV_AI_MODELS environment variable → this Mittler installation's default location (if configured) → .cache\mittler\av_ai_models in your home folder.
config.voicevox.url.description: VOICEVOX engine URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:50021 if empty (a clip's voicevox.url takes precedence).
config.presetsDir.description: Directory containing character presets (where characters.json is located). If empty, searches in order: the MITTLER_PRESETS environment variable → presets\characters next to the repository (development version only) → this Mittler installation's default location (if configured and present) → none.
config.codex.path.description: Path to the Codex CLI used to generate images for planned shots (passed to the job runner as the MITTLER_CODEX environment variable). Defaults to codex on PATH if empty.
config.image.engine.description: Default engine for generating start/end images of planned shots when not specified per image. Options: codex (Codex CLI), openai (OpenAI Image API; key from Windows Credential Manager ps:OPENAI_API_KEY or the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable), nanobanana (Nano Banana / Gemini; uses the same key as Gemini TTS). Defaults to codex if empty.
config.openai.imageModel.description: OpenAI image model for planned shots (any Image API model ID). Defaults to gpt-image-2.5-sunburst if empty. Individual images can also override the model in the editor.
config.gemini.imageModel.description: Nano Banana (Gemini) image model for planned shots (any Gemini API image model ID). Defaults to gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro) if empty. Uses the same API key as Gemini TTS (ps:GEMINI_API_KEY).
config.gemini.imageSize.description: Nano Banana image resolution (1K, 2K, 4K). Defaults to 2K if empty.
config.openai.imageQuality.description: OpenAI image quality (xhigh and max are supported only on 2.5 models). Defaults to high if empty.
config.codex.model.description: Codex model used to generate images for planned shots (passed to the job runner as the MITTLER_CODEX_MODEL environment variable). Defaults to gpt-6.1-sol if empty.
config.tools.python.description: Python executable used for helper tools (planned-shot job runner, TTS, H3 adapter; standard library only). Defaults to python on PATH if empty.
config.bake.jobs.description: Number of parallel processes for background pre-rendering. When enabled via the editor's hourglass button (off by default), frames ahead of the playhead are rendered at low priority while idle and cached in the project's work/cache/frames/. If empty, automatically chosen from half the logical processors minus 2 and available memory. Set to 0 to disable background rendering.
config.blender.path.description: Path to blender.exe for the Blender 3D effect (passed to rendering as the MITTLER_BLENDER environment variable). If empty, searches in order: the MITTLER_BLENDER environment variable → this Mittler installation's default location (if configured and present) → blender on PATH.
config.cache.dir.description: Folder for regenerable caches (rendered frames, master export intermediates, Blender renders). If empty, they are kept in each project's work/ folder. Set this when your projects are synced or backed up by Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, etc., so that thousands of cached frames are not uploaded. Each project gets its own subfolder. Reload the window after changing it.
config.master.esrgan.description: Path to the Real-ESRGAN (ncnn-vulkan) upscaler executable for master export. If empty, uses this Mittler installation's default location (if configured); otherwise specify it here.
config.master.esrganModel.description: Upscaling model for master export. Defaults to realesr-animevideov3 if empty.
config.master.rife.description: Path to the RIFE (ncnn-vulkan) frame interpolation executable for master export. If empty, uses this Mittler installation's default location (if configured); otherwise specify it here.
config.master.scale.description: Canvas scale factor for master export (effects' ctx.scale). Defaults to 2 if empty (renders an FHD project at 4K).
config.master.fps.description: Frame rate (fps) for master export; effects render at this fps and video sources are interpolated beforehand. Defaults to 60 if empty.
config.master.outHeight.description: Output video height for master export (scaled down before encoding). Defaults to 1080 if empty. Set to 0 to export at 4K without downscaling.
config.master.cacheGb.description: Size limit in GB for the master export upscale/interpolation cache (stored in the project's work/master). Defaults to 50 if empty.
